properties.label: opcodes
properties.text: Verify SELFDESTRUCT only records a revertible destroy mark in the state journal and that the deletion guard is re-evaluated at commit against the final journaled balance/state, so any credit arriving after the mark deterministically cancels the deletion.
properties.assertion: ∀a. destroy_account(a)@commit ⇒ guard(a) evaluated on final journaled state ∧ (∃credit(a) after mark_destroy(a) ⇒ ¬destroy_account(a))

properties.label: opcodes
properties.text: Verify every state-commit path applies the tx destruct set strictly after all same-tx balance credits (including beneficiary==self), deleting the account and its trie node so no later credit re-creates a nonzero-balance account in the state root.
properties.assertion: forall a in destructed(tx): order(delete(a)) > max order(credit(a,*)) in tx AND post.trie[a] == absent AND post.balance(a) == 0

properties.label: opcodes
properties.text: Verify every state-write path (set_account_balance, storage/nonce/code, touch) consults the destroyed-account set so no write after destroy_account resurrects state, and that journal revert/commit restores that set atomically with the writes it undoes.
properties.assertion: forall w in writes(tx): w.addr in destroyed(tx) && w.seq > destroy_seq(w.addr) => !persisted(w); revert(j) => destroyed == destroyed@j

properties.label: transactions
properties.text: Verify the batch state-update path re-reads each account's balance from the live journal at the moment of the credit/debit, so a balance cached before an earlier same-batch update to that account can never be the base of the write.
properties.assertion: forall upd_i(a,delta) in batch: base(upd_i) == journal_read(a, at=upd_i) && base(upd_i) != snapshot(a, before=upd_j<i)

properties.label: transactions
properties.text: Verify every balance mutation re-reads the account from the state store after any preceding journal or checkpoint write in the same transaction instead of reusing an earlier-fetched copy; a stale copy drops the intervening delta and forks the state root.
properties.assertion: forall w in balance_writes: read_seq(src(w)) > last_seq({j in journal_writes(acct(w)) | j.seq < w.seq}) /\ !reuse_pre_journal_snapshot(w)

properties.label: state-trie
properties.text: Verify every storage-write path (SSTORE, set_storage, trie_set, and revert/journal rollback) deletes the key when the new value is zero and inserts it only when nonzero, so no zero-valued entry is ever persisted and SLOAD of an absent key returns zero.
properties.assertion: forall k,v: set_storage(k,v) => (v==0 -> !trie_contains(k)) AND (v!=0 -> trie_get(k)==v); get_storage(k) == 0 when !trie_contains(k)

properties.label: state-trie
properties.text: Verify every ether-moving path checks balance >= amount before debiting and, on insufficiency, aborts and reverts all state (no recipient credit, no success receipt), so saturating subtraction can never clamp a debit to zero and silently mint the shortfall.
properties.assertion: forall move_ether(f,t,v): v > balance(f) => tx_fails && no_state_delta; never credit(t,v) paired with debit(f,d) where d < v

properties.label: opcodes
properties.text: Verify SELFDESTRUCT snapshots the balance once, zeroes the account, then credits the beneficiary with that snapshot via a checked 256-bit add, so a self-alias (beneficiary == account) burns the value instead of re-crediting a stale pre-zero balance.
properties.assertion: post.self.balance==0 && (ben==self ? sum(balances)==sum(pre)-pre.balance : post.ben==pre.ben+pre.balance && !u256_wrap)

properties.label: state-trie
properties.text: In the storage commit path, check that the value==0 branch deletes the key and drops it from the dirty/pending-write set instead of inserting an encoded zero node — a retained key perturbs the computed state root and splits consensus from peers that pruned it.
properties.assertion: forall s,k: write(s,k,0) => k NOTIN dirty(s') AND k NOTIN trie(s') AND support(s') SUBSET support(s)\{k} AND root(s')=root(commit_skip_k)

properties.label: gas
properties.text: Verify intrinsic-cost, gas-limit×price, and value sums in validate/process_transaction use checked or arbitrary-precision arithmetic, and that admission rejects any transaction whose upfront cost overflows rather than wrapping into a passing balance check.
properties.assertion: forall tx: admit(tx) <-> (no_wrap(intrinsic(tx) + gas_limit*gas_price + value) && balance(sender) >= upfront_cost(tx))

properties.label: block-processing
properties.text: Verify every fee-burn/destroy_account call in block processing bounds-checks the burn amount — base_fee_per_gas × gas_used via overflow-checked arithmetic, asserted ≤ payer balance — and rejects the block on failure instead of wrapping or saturating.
properties.assertion: burn(addr,amt) ⇒ addr==BURN_ADDRESS ∧ amt==checked_mul(base_fee,gas_used) ∧ amt<=balance(payer) ∧ ¬wraparound; check_fail ⇒ reject_block

properties.label: block-processing
properties.text: Verify that every fee-burn path proves balance >= burn amount before any state write, using a checked/saturating subtraction whose failure aborts the transaction and reverts, so no unsigned underflow can wrap a deficit into a huge balance.
properties.assertion: forall burn(a,amt): assert balance(a) >= amt BEFORE set_account_balance/destroy_account; use checked_sub; on failure reject tx with zero state writes

properties.label: evm
properties.text: Verify every balance mutation and issuance path routes through a checked U256 add that rejects overflow above the cap before writing state; no path may use wrapping/unchecked arithmetic or write an unvalidated balance via set_account_balance.
properties.assertion: forall p in balance_write_paths: checked_add(p.delta) && p.result <= U256_CAP && !uses_wrapping_arith(p) before state.set_account_balance

properties.label: gas
properties.text: Verify pre-execution escrow computes upfront cost (gas_limit × max_fee_per_gas + value) in checked 256-bit math and rejects when balance < cost before any debit; flag native-width or truncating multiply that wraps a huge gas_limit into an affordable cost.
properties.assertion: escrow.upfront_cost(gas_limit*max_fee+value).width>=256 && checked==true && assert(balance>=cost) before_debit && wrap_possible==false

properties.label: gas
properties.text: Verify escrow debit, base-fee burn, priority-fee credit and refund all use checked 256-bit arithmetic, with refund = escrow − charged and every debit rejected unless ≤ remaining escrow, so no wrapping subtraction can credit more than was escrowed.
properties.assertion: escrow = checked(gas_limit*max_fee_per_gas + value); every debit d requires d <= escrow_rem; refund = escrow_rem after burn+tip; no wrapping/truncating ops

properties.label: gas
properties.text: Verify the upfront escrow debit gasLimit*maxFeePerGas+value is computed in checked or widened 256-bit arithmetic and the tx is rejected when the product or sum exceeds 2^256-1, rather than wrapping to a small debit the sender's balance can cover.
properties.assertion: debit=gasLimit*maxFeePerGas+value; overflows256(debit) => reject(tx) && !wraps(debit)

properties.label: state-trie
properties.text: Confirm every balance mutation is applied via the state writer that records the account in the commit/journal set, so no path mutates a cached account struct in place; otherwise the committed trie root omits the change and diverges from peers' state root.
properties.assertion: forall m in balance_mutations: m.via(state_writer) and m.account in dirty_commit_set; committed_root reflects m; no_in_place_cached_account_write

properties.label: evm
properties.text: Verify that every EVM balance-mutating path (CALL/CREATE value transfer, gas refund, coinbase reward, withdrawal credit) checks the U256 addition/subtraction for overflow/underflow BEFORE journaling, and reverts the frame rather than wrapping the balance.
properties.assertion: forall op in balance_mutations: checked_add_or_sub(op) precedes journal_entry(op) AND overflow(op) => revert(frame) AND never wrapping_add(balance)

properties.label: opcodes
properties.text: Verify CALL handling applies the same account-touch/deletion semantics for zero-value transfers as for nonzero ones: gating touch, empty-account creation, or state-clearing on value != 0 must not exist, so every node reaches identical post-state roots.
properties.assertion: call.touch_account(target) invoked unconditionally; no branch conditions touch/empty-account creation or clearing on value != 0

properties.label: block-processing
properties.text: Verify every balance-mutating path in block processing (reward/issuance credit, withdrawal debit) bounds-checks before writing: debits require balance >= amount, credits reject overflow, and the write is rejected — not clamped or wrapped — on failure.
properties.assertion: forall p in {reward, issuance, withdrawal}: p.debit => bal >= amt checked; p.credit => bal + amt <= MAX checked; violation => reject, no set_account_balance

properties.label: transactions
properties.text: Verify the CALL/CALLCODE value-transfer path rejects the transfer when sender balance < value BEFORE any balance mutation, so a remotely craftable transaction cannot underflow the sender and mint ether; the check must gate the debit, not follow it.
properties.assertion: on CALL_value(from,to,v): assert(balance[from] >= v) strictly precedes any write to balance[from]; else abort(insufficient_funds), no state mutation

properties.label: transactions
properties.text: Verify self-transfers in CALL: confirm the sender's balance is debited and credited against a single freshly-read account state, with an unsigned-safe sufficiency check before debit, so amount==balance and sender==recipient can neither underflow nor mint.
properties.assertion: self_transfer(CALL): balance_read_once && require(bal >= amt) before debit && no_wrap(sub/add) && post_balance(sender==recipient) == pre_balance

properties.label: block-processing
properties.text: In the shared balance-credit routine, confirm the new balance is computed by a width-checked add against the balance type's maximum BEFORE the state write, and that overflow aborts block processing as invalid — never a wrapped, saturated, or truncated value.
properties.assertion: credit(bal,delta): checked_add evaluated pre-write; overflow => reject block; no wraparound, no clamp-to-MAX, no narrowing cast

properties.label: evm
properties.text: Verify every balance debit path (transfer value, gas prepay, fee burn) performs a sufficiency check against the current balance before any set_account_balance, and that the subtraction cannot wrap or produce a negative/oversized value on any reachable branch.
properties.assertion: forall debit in {value, gas_prepay, fee_burn}: check(balance >= debit) precedes set_account_balance(balance - debit) AND no_wraparound(sub)

properties.label: evm
properties.text: Verify every balance-credit path performs a checked U256 addition and aborts before state.set_account_balance on overflow, so only issuance can raise total supply and no transaction can wrap a balance; confirm all credit callers, not only transfer.
properties.assertion: forall p in balance_credit_paths: checked_add_u256(bal,amt) && (overflow => abort && !set_account_balance) && (supply_increase => issuance)

properties.label: gas
properties.text: Verify the pre-move_ether balance check for the up-front transaction fee escrow compares the sender balance against the FULL debit computed as an unbounded/checked product of gas_limit and max_fee_per_gas, rejecting the tx on overflow rather than wrapping.
properties.assertion: cost = checked_mul(gas_limit, max_fee_per_gas); cost.is_err => reject_tx; require(balance >= cost + value) before debit; !wrap

properties.label: beacon-chain:withdrawal
properties.text: Verify the withdrawal debit computes balance - amount in unbounded or width-checked arithmetic and rejects the withdrawal when amount > balance, so a crafted amount cannot wrap the account balance modulo 2^n and mint ETH.

properties.label: beacon-chain:withdrawal
properties.text: Confirm process_withdrawal's fresh-account path credits w.amount exactly once: the account must be created at zero balance before the credit (or created carrying the amount with the credit then skipped), never both, so a new recipient cannot receive 2*amount.
properties.assertion: fresh(s,w.to) => bal'(w.to) == w.amount && supply(apply(s,w)) - supply(s) == issuance_delta(w)

properties.label: state-trie
properties.text: Verify no fee-burn, refund, or reward path writes a balance by mutating the trie node, account struct, or state cache entry directly: each write must go through the journaled balance setter, so a later revert or error return unwinds it via the snapshot.
properties.assertion: forall w in balance_writes(fee_burn|refund|reward): w.via==journaled_set_balance && !direct_trie_or_cache_mut(w) && revert(tx)=>undo(w)

properties.label: block-processing
properties.text: Verify the internal ether transfer helper rejects value > balance[from] before mutating any account, returning an error on the same code path that reads the balance — no path may debit `from` (or credit `to`) after a failed or absent balance comparison.

properties.text: Verify SELFDESTRUCT credits the beneficiary the full balance first — with no early-return or skip when beneficiary aliases self, is empty, or is a precompile — then unconditionally zeroes the account in the same atomic step, so self-beneficiary burns funds.
properties.assertion: selfdestruct: move_ether(self,beneficiary,balance) executed unconditionally THEN balance[self]=0; no branch on beneficiary==self/empty/precompile

properties.label: state-trie
